answer: Before earning, each agent must post a fixed bond onto the public ledge of the protocol, and reward per identity is capped below that bond's carrying cost. Fielding N fake agents means locking N bonds at once, since a fresh key with no collateral earns zero and cannot vote. A headcount of ten thousand sockpuppets therefore costs ten thousand idle bonds, slashed if caught. One operator on one terrace earns what the attacker's best identity earns, so honest work wins. A cooldown forces the stack across many epochs. A willow of clones stays unprofitable.
